breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to 'take the maximum in-plane shear to be the average transverse shear stress alone' but then provided the correct formula that includes normal stress. The ground truth removed the incorrect statement. The agent's generated specification correctly ignored the flawed instruction and instead used the provided formula, `τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²)`, which properly accounts for the contribution of the average normal stress. This aligns with the ground truth.
